Increased Ventral Striatal Volume in College-Aged Binge Drinkers

The criteria used for binge drinking were based on the National Institute on Alcoholism and Alcohol Abuse diagnostic criteria  [19] : consumption of ≥5 drinks (8 units) and ≥4 drinks (6 units) in a 2-hour period (for males and females, respectively) at least once a week for the last three months.
Participants were recruited from the Cambridgeshire region by local advertisements in both community- and university-based settings.
